title: PR's '117/119 T2 PNGs pixel-identical' denominator does not reconcile with the 113 committed T2 goldens; the correct statement is 111/113
evidence: PR body claim: "Proven: 117/119 T2 PNGs **pixel-identical** before/after the / re-bless". The chunk contains EXACTLY two PNG changes (both dublin_board): "diff --git a/goldens/dublin_board/30000ms.png b/goldens/dublin_board/30000ms.png / index 9d6683e..72835f2 100644 / Binary files a/goldens/dublin_board/30000ms.png and b/goldens/dublin_board/30000ms.png differ" and "diff --git a/goldens/dublin_board/90000ms.png b/goldens/dublin_board/90000ms.png / index 8d575fc..c901e3d 100644 / Binary files a/goldens/dublin_board/90000ms.png and b/goldens/dublin_board/90000ms.png differ". Worktree at 93333cd: find goldens -name '*.t1' | wc -l = 51, '*.log.bin' = 49, '*.png' = 113 (chunk: 51 t1 + 49 bin + 2 png = 102 files, all under goldens/) — so 111 of 113 committed T2s are pixel-identical, not 117 of 119.
detail: The .t1 (51/51) and .log.bin (49/49) totals reconcile exactly with the chunk; only the PNG denominator (119) exceeds the committed T2 golden set (113) by six, leaving the dual-run pixel proof (rule 1) on an unexplained count.
recommended_fix: Restate as 111/113 committed T2 PNGs pixel-identical (2 dublin_board re-blessed), or document which six non-golden captures the 119 counts.
